Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulum al- Qur’an • The miraculous nature of the Qur’an • Language of t
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do Muslims learn from Surah al-Hujurat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding
3. apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SELECTED CHAPTER SURAH AL- HUJURAT
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SELECTED CHAPTER SURAH AL- HUJURAT
Study Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment

What this means
In this part you learn to read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat in your own words. (skill: explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment.
3. Practise this skill: explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding.
4. Practise this skill: apply the teachings of Surah al- Hujurat in their daily life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do Muslims learn from Surah al-Hujurat?
2. How can Muslims use Surah al- Hujurat to enhance peace in the community?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read Surah al-Hujurat (Q 49) correctly for spiritual nourishment.
5. Be able to: explain the meaning of the verses of Surah al-Hujurat for better understanding.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
